function.name: search_by_content
function.description: Full-text search over note title and body. Returns notes whose content matches the query string. Use when the user query mentions a topic, keyword, or phrase. Does not filter by tag or date.

query.description: Text query matched against note title and body.

function.name: search_by_tags
function.description: Find notes tagged with a given set of tags. All listed tags must be present on the note (AND logic). Use when the query references tags directly. Does not filter by content or date.

tags.description: List of tags the note must have. All tags must be present (AND logic).

function.name: search_by_date
function.description: Find notes whose creation date falls within an inclusive range. Use when the query specifies a time window. Does not filter by content or tag.

date_from.description: Inclusive lower bound on creation date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

date_to.description: Inclusive upper bound on creation date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.name: get_note_by_path
function.description: Retrieve the full contents of a single note using its exact file path. Use when the path is already known. Not for searching or browsing.

path.description: Exact file path of the note (e.g., 'vault/folder/note.md').

function.name: get_note_by_title
function.description: Retrieve the full contents of a single note using its title. Use when the title is already known. Not for searching or browsing.

title.description: Title of the note, which is the filename without the .md extension.

function.name: get_outgoing_links
function.description: List notes that a given source note links to through wiki-style [[links]]. Identify the source note by its file path. Use for queries about what a note references.

path.description: Exact file path of the source note.

function.name: get_incoming_links
function.description: List notes that link to a given target note (backlinks) through wiki-style [[links]]. Identify the target note by its title. Use for queries about what references a note.

title.description: Title of the target note (filename without the .md extension).

function.name: get_vault_stats
function.description: Get overall vault statistics: total note count, notes per folder, and the full set of tags. Use when the query asks about the vault as a whole. Does not list recent notes.

function.name: get_recent_notes
function.description: List the most recently modified notes in the vault, ordered newest first. Use when the query asks about recent activity.

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return. Defaults to 10.

function.name: create_note
function.description: Create a new markdown note in the vault with a path, title, and body content. Does not set tags or links; use add_tags_to_note and add_link_to_note for those after creation.

path.description: Relative file path inside the vault (e.g., 'synthesis/Weekly_Recap.md'). The .md extension is added if missing.

title.description: Title for the YAML frontmatter. Defaults to the filename with underscores replaced by spaces.

content.description: Body of the note in markdown. Optional.

function.name: add_tags_to_note
function.description: Add one or more tags to the YAML frontmatter of an existing note. Tags are deduplicated. Does not modify body or links.

path.description: Relative file path of the target note inside the vault.

tags.description: Tags to add to the note's YAML frontmatter.

function.name: add_link_to_note
function.description: Append a wiki-style [[link]] to the body of an existing note. Spaces in the target title are converted to underscores so backlinks resolve correctly. Does not modify tags.

path.description: Relative file path of the source note inside the vault.

target_title.description: Title of the note to link to (filename without .md, e.g., 'Transformers' or 'Attention Mechanisms').
